interface.title: AgroInteligência — Previsão e Viabilidade de Safra (Soja no Pará)
interface.field: Agronomy / agricultural economics (soybean yield forecasting, Pará, Brazil)
interface.stage_of_work: Interpreting and communicating model results; decision support built on a published dataset
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick a Pará municipality and read its next-season soybean yield projection with its error margin, set it against the official IBGE/PAM history and its repeated values, test climate scenarios, browse a state map, and turn the yield into a per-hectare economic margin from CONAB price and cost, with CSV export.

data.note: 451 records, 38 municipalities, 2001–2025, shipped with the app (soja_para_painel.csv plus geo, CONAB and Receita Federal reference values). The live Pará monthly price lookup could not be reached ('A série mensal do Pará não pôde ser consultada agora'), so the bundled CONAB Pedro Afonso (TO) March 2026 figures were used: R$105.09/sc and R$5,277/ha. The first load took about 20 s.

tree.general: Forecast a region's crop yield with its uncertainty, judge how reliable the official record is, and work out whether growing the crop pays
tree.specific: Read the next-season soybean yield projection for a Pará municipality, compare it with the PAM/IBGE history and repeated values, simulate climate, view the map, compute revenue, cost and margin per hectare, and export the CSV

features.name: Click-to-select point map with primary and comparison highlight
features.general: Show sites as proportional circles colored by a measured value. Hover one to name it, click one to make it the active site, and pick a second site for comparison with its own highlight color.
features.specific: Folium map of Pará municípios: circles sized by planted area and colored by recent yield (viridis legend 45–75 sc/ha or 2,700–4,500 kg/ha). Clicking a circle sets the sidebar município (red ring). The comparison município gets a blue ring.
steps: zoom or pan the map
hover a circle to see the município name
click a circle to make it the main município (sidebar and cards update)
turn on Comparar and choose a second município to get the blue ring
serves_tasks: Browse producing regions on a map sized by area and colored by yield, and pick one by clicking
Add a second region for side-by-side comparison

features.name: Forecast card with validation metrics and baseline comparison
features.general: Show a point forecast with its typical error next to cross-validation scores, including a baseline-only score and the model's added increment over the baseline, so the user sees whether the model beats the baseline.
features.specific: 'Projeção · safra N' card with ± RMSE, beside RMSE, rRMSE 13.6%, model R² and trend-only R² (both 0.253), and the card note that the model adds only about +0.7 to +1.1 kg/ha over the Tendência Tecnológica trend.
steps: pick a município
read the projection and its ± error
compare model R² with trend-only R²
read the note on how much the model adds over the trend
serves_tasks: Pick the region to study and read its forecast with its error margin, and whether the model beats a trend-only baseline

features.name: Bounded what-if sliders with a significance note
features.general: Let the user set input drivers only within the range seen in the data, show how far the prediction moves, and state plainly whether that shift is inside the model's noise.
features.specific: 'Simular outro cenário climático': precipitation (1,165–2,908 mm) and potential evapotranspiration sliders start at the município's climatology. 'Projeção ajustada' shows the delta (0 to ±2 kg/ha) with an explanation (r = −0.109, n = 451, 59 kg/ha spread against a 413 kg/ha error).
steps: open the expander
drag the rainfall slider
drag the evapotranspiration slider
read the adjusted projection and delta badge
switch to kg/ha to see small deltas
serves_tasks: Set seasonal rainfall and evaporative demand within the observed range and see how far the forecast moves

features.name: Time-series chart with event bands, trend and dashed forecast
features.general: Plot observed values for one or two sites over time with a fitted trend, shaded event periods and a dashed forecast whose hover shows the error margin. Drag to zoom into a period, double-click to reset, and toggle series from the legend.
features.specific: 'Evolução histórica da produtividade' (Plotly): PAM yield for main and comparison município, Tendência Tecnológica, El Niño/La Niña bands, and the 3 projected seasons whose hover shows ± 412.8 kg/ha.
steps: hover a point for the year's yield or projection ± margin
drag across years to zoom
click legend items to hide the trend or bands
double-click to reset zoom
serves_tasks: Plot observed yields over time with trend, climate-phase bands and the dashed forecast with its margin, and spot years that repeat the year before

features.name: Record-repetition reliability panel
features.general: Score how often a site's official record repeats the previous value, give the longest stuck run, compare with the regional average, and flag above-average sites.
features.specific: 'Confiabilidade dos registros oficiais': Repetição de dados locais (57% São Félix do Xingu, 17% Paragominas), Maior sequência travada (3 safras), Média no Pará 39.5%, and a callout 'Repetição acima/abaixo da média do estado'.
steps: select a município
read its repeat rate and longest run
compare with the state average
read the above- or below-average callout
serves_tasks: Measure how often the official record repeats the previous year, against the state average

features.name: Per-hectare margin simulator with data-age warning, uncertainty band and verdict
features.general: From an editable unit price, cost per area and yield, compute revenue, cost and margin per area. Warn when the reference price is old and set it against other markets, carry the forecast error into a min–max band, and give one of three verdicts depending on whether the band crosses zero.
features.specific: Simulador de viabilidade financeira: price R$/sc and cost R$/ha (CONAB Pedro Afonso defaults, with the 'Preço possivelmente desatualizado… há 7 meses' warning and port/Chicago and Pedro Afonso comparisons) plus productivity sc/ha (defaults to the model or farm expectation). Shows Receita bruta, Custo, Margem with ranges, % over cost, full-cost margin after CONAB factor rent, Receita Federal VTN, and a Síntese IA verdict: Inconclusivo, Alta Viabilidade or Risco Operacional Crítico.
steps: read the reference price's age warning and market comparisons
edit the sack price and the operating cost per ha
optionally override productivity (or set the farm expectation in the sidebar)
read the revenue, cost and margin cards with ranges
read the verdict
serves_tasks: Turn the yield into revenue, cost and margin per hectare from editable price and cost, with a band from the forecast error, a warning when the reference price is old, and a plain-language verdict

features.name: Sortable, searchable ranking table
features.general: Rank all sites by an estimated value and show each site's record count and data-quality score beside it, with column sort, search and show/hide columns.
features.specific: 'Ranking dos polos produtivos' st.dataframe: Município, Média Recente (2021–2025) kg/ha, Faturamento Bruto Est. R$/ha (at the current price), Área Atual, Repetição Oficial, Total de Safras, with toolbar search, sort and fullscreen.
steps: read the ranking by revenue
click a column header to sort
scroll right to Total de Safras
search a município name
serves_tasks: Rank all regions by estimated revenue and check each one's record reliability

screens_never_reached: 'Preço da soja no Pará' monthly price series: the live source was unreachable, and the section shows only 'A série mensal do Pará não pôde ser consultada agora' (screens/044.webp)
not_done: Estimating total production in tons and sacas: no control or output for total production (area × yield) appeared in any of the three views. The app gives only per-hectare yield and economics, plus area in the ranking table and area chart.
Exporting the ranking table through its toolbar 'Download as CSV' icon: two clicks produced no file in this headless browser.

Comparing the comparison município's projection or economics side by side: the comparison appears only on the map and the two historical charts. The forecast card, finance view and reliability panel show the main município only.
Simulating temperature directly: the scenario offers rainfall and potential evapotranspiration, not temperature.
Repeated values are not flagged on the chart itself: repeats show only as flat segments and as the summary percentages in the reliability panel.

Observations, not blockers: (1) On first load the sidebar showed Abel Figueiredo while the cards showed Paragominas (screens/004.webp). (2) The projection card follows the sidebar 'Expectativa Produtiva da Fazenda' baseline rather than the model. Paragominas 2027 read 3,922 kg/ha with baseline 65 and 3,022 with baseline 50 (screens/053.webp, screens/054.webp), while the chart's model projection was about 3,300. (3) The map often jumped to odd zoom levels, up to world scale, after reruns. (4) Hiding the La Niña legend item did not remove its bands. (5) The 'Repetição Oficial' column sorts as text (0%, 10%, 100%). (6) The history chart always projects 2026–2028 whatever Safra Alvo is set to.
